Install deadline action at T0+45m with ASG min0/max1/desired0, then set existing ASG min1/max1/desired1.
Verify sole new private t3.micro, LT3/AMI/subnet/SG/30GiB encrypted deleting root, SSM online and Standard CPU credits.

If the next plan is not approved in time or a check fails, restore ASG min0/max1/desired0, terminate only this host, verify root deletion and remove the owned scheduled action. RDS remains stopped throughout this first phase.
later_checks: Actual signed-in regular and temporary callers with selected human test accounts
S3 intent/upload/confirm/display and resource ownership/terminal denials using synthetic image bytes
Hosted Conversations login with the new principal and cross-domain matrix

Final evidence, owner review, FR-03 and task acceptance
retention: Keep existing RDS/data/roles/SSM/images/network/NAT/storage. Later synthetic image and its listing must be retained together or removed only by a separately reviewed safe cleanup.
human_dependencies: A human must sign in with real accounts and update DNS if the separately approved HTTPS test uses a new proxy IP. No OTP, password or token enters chat.
